stem: Which practice most directly helps keyboard-only users?

options.rationale: Shows keyboard users where they are on the page.
Can distract users and does not help keyboard navigation.
Makes pointing and keyboard focus harder to use.

options.text: Using color alone to show status
options.rationale: Excludes users who cannot perceive the color difference.

explanation: A visible focus indicator shows keyboard users where they are on the page as they move through interactive controls.
